turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on describing appearance?
turns.tutor:
Hello! To describe a person, we use has/have for what they have (hair, eyes) and is for personality. Example: She has long hair. She is kind. Remember: he, she and it use has.

Exercise: Complete: "My cousin ___ brown eyes." (has / have)
